content.what_it_is: Commented MATLAB script under vessel_types_compare that selects eta outputs 20 and 40 with displayed labels, sizes a unit-spaced grid from eta_00001, and renders two stacked pcolor panels with fixed ±1.5 limits (L1-L62).
entities: output directory fdir defined at L9
selected output vector nfile defined at L12
time-label cell array times defined at L15
eta loaded at L20 and reassigned at L43
initial dimensions n and m defined at L21
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L24-L25
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L26-L27
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L30-L31
loop index num defined at L36
formatted suffix fnum defined at L40

params_defined.name: times
params_defined.range: one displayed time per selected output

equations.ref: x coordinates from initial eta columns
y coordinates from initial eta rows

verbatim_spans.text: % Time values for series in minutes

unresolved: Direct copy/paste evidence: this current vessel_types_compare file is byte-identical (same source hash bcd6ed6b...) to the gate-read vessel_flat_bottom/postprocessing/plot_wave_vessel_commented.m, including its 20/40 selections and ±1.5 range. Whether those flat-bottom settings are valid for the vessel-types comparison is not established in this file.
Unit inconsistency across L14 and L54: the input comment defines times as minutes, but the rendered title labels the same values as seconds.
Cross-file shape assumption across L20-L27 and L43-L49: coordinates are derived only from eta_00001, but selected eta arrays are not checked for matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and times arrays at L12 and L15 are jointly indexed at L40 and L54 without an equal-length check; editing only one can make times{num} out of range.
MATLAB pcolor at L49 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces.
